extDescription: Fast playback speed control for any web video. Shortcuts, skip silence, speed rules. 100% local, zero tracking.
privacy_line: 100% local, zero tracking. Settings stay in your browser; the only network call is license verification.
cta_microcopy: Includes all future updates & features — no recurring fees
unlock_title: Unlock speeds up to {1} with Pro (7-Day Free Trial)
pro_modal_active: SpeedUP Video Pro is active! Enjoy unlimited speed and precision.
tier_badge_title: Click to activate Pro or start the free trial
license_state_limit: Key used on too many devices
license_verdict_expired: This trial or license has expired.
license_verdict_revoked: This license key has been deactivated.
license_verdict_limit: This key is already used on too many devices.
license_verdict_unreachable: Couldn't reach the license server. Check your connection and try again.
review_text: You've saved {1} with SpeedUp. Would you rate it? It really helps.
shortcuts_sub: Click a key to change it, + to add another, × to remove.
preferred_value_desc: Target speed for the preferred-speed key
overlay_hint: The on-video badge confirms every action. Drag it to move it (saved per site).
bookmarks_empty: No bookmarks saved for this video.
skip_silence_unavailable: Not available on this player (cross-origin audio).
skip_silence_unavailable_overlay: Skip silence unavailable on this player
rules_open_page: Open a page with a video to create a rule.
rules_free: Saved rules: {1}. Rules apply automatically with Pro.
rule_channel_unavailable: Channel rules work on YouTube video pages
yt_ads_desc: Speed and sound come back when the ad ends.
hold_hint: Hold {1} for {2}, release to go back.
upsell_frames: Frame-by-frame stepping is a Pro feature (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_skip: Quick seek is not available on your plan.
upsell_bookmarks: Video bookmarks are a Pro feature (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_skipSilence: Skip silence speeds through pauses automatically. Pro (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_rules: Speed rules per channel, video or site are a Pro feature (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_youtubeAds: YouTube ads at 16x and muted is a Pro feature (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_holdToSpeed: Hold-to-speed is a Pro feature (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_statsDetails: See time saved today, this week and in total with Pro (7-Day Free Trial).
upsell_abRepeat: A-B repeat is a Pro feature (7-Day Free Trial).
action_abRepeat_desc: Set A, set B, clear · Pro
opt_speed_step_hint: Used by the Slower/Faster shortcuts and the popup fine buttons.
opt_preferred_hint: Toggled by the Preferred speed shortcut. Your plan allows up to {1}.
opt_remember: Remember the last speed for new pages (otherwise start at 1.0x)
opt_apply_all: Apply speed changes to every video/audio on the page (default: only the active one)
opt_pitch: Preserve audio pitch at high speed
opt_overlay_show: Show the speed overlay on videos
opt_overlay_drag: Drag the overlay on any video to move it; the position is saved per site.
opt_shortcuts_hint: Shortcuts never fire while you type in a text field or editor. Defaults match Video Speed Controller.
opt_pro_off: You can configure these now; they turn on when Pro is active (7-Day Free Trial from the popup).
opt_ss_enable: Speed up automatically while the audio is silent
opt_ss_threshold_hint: Lower = only true silence counts. Try −50 for quiet speakers.
opt_ss_before_hint: Margin before: short pauses between words are left alone.
opt_ss_after_hint: Margin after: avoids flicker on choppy audio.
opt_ss_note: Works on players that serve audio from the same site (YouTube, most course platforms). On players that stream cross-origin audio without permission it turns itself off and tells you, instead of speeding everything up.
opt_hold_speed: Speed while the key is held
opt_hold_hint: Assign the key in Keyboard shortcuts → Hold to speed.
opt_yt_ads_enable: Play YouTube ads at 16x and muted, then restore speed and sound
opt_rules_hint: Priority: channel → URL pattern → site → your default. URL patterns use * and are matched without https:// and www. (e.g. udemy.com/course/*). Channel = @handle, channel ID (UC…) or exact name.
opt_rules_empty: No rules yet. Create one from the popup (Smart tab) or below.
opt_blacklist_hint: One domain per line. Subdomains are included (google.com also covers docs.google.com).
opt_sync_enable: Sync settings across devices signed in to this browser
opt_sync_hint: License, statistics and bookmarks stay on this device.
opt_sync_status_quota: Sync paused: settings are larger than the browser's sync quota.
opt_sync_status_error: Last sync attempt failed; it will retry on the next change.
opt_import_paste_hint: Or paste a SpeedUp export, or Video Speed Controller settings JSON:
opt_import_ok_vsc: Imported {1} settings from Video Speed Controller.
opt_import_err_format: Unrecognised file: expected a SpeedUp export or Video Speed Controller settings.
opt_import_err_version: This export comes from a newer version of SpeedUp. Update the extension first.
onb_tagline: Watch any web video at the speed you want — with the keyboard, without leaving the page.
onb_pin_body: Click the puzzle icon in the toolbar and pin SpeedUp, so speed and settings are one click away.
onb_demo_body: Press Play, then use the keys below. They work the same way on YouTube, courses and any other HTML5 video.
onb_trial_body: Free covers speed up to 4x and every shortcut. Pro adds the tools that save the most time:
onb_trial_f2: Skip silence in lectures and podcasts
onb_trial_f3: Automatic speed per channel, video or site
onb_trial_f4: YouTube ads at 16x muted, hold-to-speed, A-B repeat, time-saved stats
changelog_18_license: License checked once a day in the background, with 7 days of offline grace.
changelog_18_sync: Settings sync across your devices (Chrome/Edge sync).
changelog_18_import: Export/import settings, and import from Video Speed Controller.
changelog_18_languages: Now in English, Italiano, Español, Deutsch, Français, Português (Brasil) and 日本語.
changelog_18_onboarding: New welcome page with an interactive shortcut demo.
changelog_17_skip: Pro: skip silence in lectures and podcasts.
changelog_17_rules: Pro: speed rules per channel, video or site.
changelog_17_stats: Time saved: see how much time you saved this week.
changelog_16_free: Free plan now goes up to 4x, with custom shortcuts and ±10 s seek.
changelog_16_shortcuts: Video Speed Controller–compatible shortcuts (S, D, R, Z, X, V, G).
changelog_16_overlay: New draggable on-video overlay that also works in fullscreen.
changelog_16_persist: Speed survives ads, quality changes and playlists; native player menus are respected.
overlay_seek_unsupported: Seeking isn't supported on this site
site_access_body: Firefox asks you to grant access to websites before extensions can work on them. SpeedUp only touches video and audio elements and never reads or sends page content.
site_access_granted: ✓ Access granted. Shortcuts and the overlay now work on every site.
site_access_popup: SpeedUp needs access to websites to control their videos.
